subject: Request: privacy readiness docs for procurement & Art.28/30 review
messages:
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@novamed.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-13T09:14:00Z
Subject: Pre-contract privacy checklist and Art.28/30 artifacts request

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for taking this procurement sprint with us. Our privacy and security team needs a compact package to complete our legal review before we sign the DPA and finalize the SOW. Can you provide the following by EOD Friday (2026-09-17)?

1) A short DPIA/executive summary that explains high-level processing, lawful basis, risk mitigations, and any residual risks.
2) An exportable snapshot of the current subprocessor inventory with regions and transfer mechanisms.
3) An Art.28/30 mapping or ledger showing subprocessors, categories of data, and retention references.
4) Evidence of encryption-in-transit and at-rest controls (cipher suites, KMS proofs, key rotation cadence).
5) A sample ledger excerpt or audit-ready log (redacted) showing a customer data access event.

If some items need to be provided through your compliance portal or an NDA, flag that and we’ll coordinate. Also let us know if you need a brief call to walk through the artifacts.

Maria Gonzalez
Head of Procurement, NovaMed Health
procurement@novamed.com
From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@novamed.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-13T10:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Pre-contract privacy checklist and Art.28/30 artifacts request

Hi Maria — thanks for the clear list. We can assemble a concise package; below is what we plan to deliver and a proposed timeline.

Planned deliverables (single ZIP + drive folder):
- DPIA executive summary (2 pages) + high-level process map
- Subprocessor inventory CSV export (filtered to your relevant regions)
- Art.28/30 mapping ledger (CSV) with data categories and retention references
- KMS proof package: rotation schedule excerpt + signed export of CMK audit lines
- Redacted audit log sample showing an operator access event (no PII included)

Timeline: initial package by 2026-09-15 EOD; full audit-portal upload (for secure viewing) by 2026-09-17. If you need anything sooner we can prioritize the DPIA and subprocessor CSV first.

One question: for the audit log sample, do you prefer a set of syslog lines (text) or a CSV ledger extract? We can provide both but want to send the format you’ll ingest.

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Manager, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-13T11:35:00Z
Subject: Re: Pre-contract privacy checklist and Art.28/30 artifacts request

Hannah / Marissa — quick legal note for the deliverables list so packaging is audit-ready:

- DPIA executive summary should include a short paragraph on the legal basis (processor services under customer instruction), subprocessors clause reference, and the fallback controls for cross-border transfers (SCCs + additional safeguards).
- For Art.28/30 mapping, include columns: subprocessors, processing activities, categories of data, legal basis, country, transfer mechanism, retention policy reference, and last attest date.
- Subprocessor CSV: redact third-party contact emails but include company name and jurisdiction.
- KMS proof: provide a signed excerpt of key rotation metadata (hash + timestamp) and a summary of HSM/KMS provider compliance (SOC2 + OECD equivalency note if applicable).

I’ve prepared a short template for the ledger format and added it to the drive link Hannah mentioned — will attach the template to the package.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference
From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@novamed.com>, NovaMed Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-15T17:22:00Z
Subject: Delivery: privacy readiness package + secure links (Redwood -> NovaMed)

Hi Maria — attaching the compact package we discussed. Files attached and uploaded to the secure audit portal: https://secure.redwood.com/audit-portal/request/NR-9831

Attachments included:
- Redwood_DPIA-Executive-Summary_2026-06.pdf (2 pages) — quick risk summary and mitigations
- subprocessors_inventory_snapshot_2026-08.csv — inventory filtered to EU jurisdictions
- art28-30-mapping-ledger_2026-09.csv — ledger format per Laura’s template
- kms_rotation_audit_excerpt.txt — signed excerpt showing key rotation hash & timestamp
- audit_log_sample_redacted.txt — redacted syslog lines illustrating a customer data access event

Notes / highlights:
- Transfers from our EU clusters are governed by SCCs and layered technical controls; the ledger row for our cloud provider lists the transfer mechanism.
- The KMS excerpt is a short, signed metadata file (no plaintext keys). We can provide HSM attestation docs under NDA if needed.
- If you want a walkthrough I can set a 30-min call with Laura and Marissa this week to run through the artifacts.

Next steps: please confirm whether the package is sufficient for your DPA review or whether you need expanded logs (we can produce a 30‑day sample within the portal under a controlled sharing agreement).

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Manager, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Delivery: privacy readiness package + secure links (Redwood -> NovaMed)

Thanks Hannah — received and shared with our privacy team. The DPIA summary and ledger format look good at first pass. We’ll confirm by Monday if we need the 30‑day log sample or HSM attestation. If we do, we’ll request the portal access link for secure retrieval.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

— Maria
